item.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

  • Added 'No Grenades' style for the General's Greatcoat
  • Fixed regression in the Sandwich Diner war paint
  • Fixed an exploit where the Dragon's Fury could crash the server
  • Updated the in-game item importer to support the Medic's backpack bodygroup
  • Updated the style

item.title: Update 2.59.0.62
item.description:
Sound

  • Now, when opening the aircraft or helicopter cockpit in flight, the sound of the rushing airflow will drown out all sounds, such as engines and missiles. Previously, this was controlled by the player’s engine volume slider.
